title: Drifter Bar Salts Sweet Mint 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Drifter Bar Salts Sweet Mint is a wonderfully refreshing and cooling e-liquid, offering a clean and crisp mint flavour with a subtly sweet undertone. This blend provides an uplifting vaping experience, perfect for those who enjoy a fresh, minty taste that's not overpowering. As you inhale, the refreshing mint flavour gently unfolds, offering a cooling sensation that's both invigorating and soothing. The mint is delicately balanced with a hint of sweetness, enhancing the overall experience without overwhelming the crisp minty essence. This makes for a delightful vape that's both satisfying and light, ideal for all-day vaping or as a palate cleanser between other flavours. Formulated for use in starter vape kits and low-powered pod devices, Drifter's Bar Salts e-liquids utilise nicotine salts for a smoother experience at higher nicotine strengths. This formulation also allows for quicker nicotine absorption, providing swift relief for those needing immediate satisfaction. This makes them an ideal choice for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking immediate, satisfying nicotine relief. Drifter's Bar Salts and Bar Juice collections offer mouth-watering e-liquids inspired by the most popular flavours found in disposable vapes. They're just as intensely delicious and satisfying as disposable vape flavours, but with the added benefit of being compatible with your own reusable vape device. This saves you money and reduces waste in the process. Why not try other incredible flavours from Drifter's Bar Salts and Bar Juice collections? From sweet and refreshing Cotton Candy Ice to classics like Cherry and Blue Razz Lemonade, whatever your taste in e-liquid, Drifter E-liquid has an incredible flavour waiting to light up your tastebuds.
